identity.exchangeName: CF Industries Holdings, Inc. Common Stock

risks: Blue Point is a multiyear capital project with construction, carbon-sequestration, offtake and policy execution risk before expected 2029 production.
Q2 sales volumes were 15% lower year over year and the Yazoo City outage reduced product availability; nitrogen earnings remain exposed to gas costs and global supply-demand swings.
Blue Point depends on multiyear construction, CCS infrastructure, partner performance and policy/economic support through 2029 startup.
Low-carbon ammonia competes with conventional ammonia and potentially green-electrolysis routes; relative gas, power and carbon economics can change the preferred pathway.
Nitrogen pricing and earnings remain sensitive to global outages, conflict, trade flows and natural-gas cost differentials.
Yazoo City outage reduces product availability until expected first-half 2027 restart and illustrates concentrated asset-operability risk.
Low-carbon project returns depend on construction discipline, CCS availability, tax-credit/policy durability and contracted/market offtake economics.
unknowns: Long-run premium realization for low-carbon ammonia and final project returns remain uncertain.
Normalization of nitrogen pricing after conflict-related supply disruptions is uncertain.
Realized low-carbon premium and full-cycle return on CF's equity plus $550M shared infrastructure remain uncertain.
Normalized nitrogen pricing after conflict-related disruptions and the ultimate Blue Point low-carbon premium remain uncertain.
contradictions: Strong earnings and pricing coexist with materially lower sales volumes, partly reflecting outage and customer timing effects.

Strong first-half earnings and pricing coexist with lower physical sales volumes; the difference is substantially explained by tighter supply/pricing, outage effects and a litigation gain rather than broad volume expansion.
